items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: your boy gave me credit for this too, Doc, what’s his name? He gave me credit today for bringing up the church.

ctx.x: Do you think it’s a good thing that that’s happened?

It’s a good thing 50-50. 50 yes and 50 no. Because a lot of new people have misled, at least a quarter, a quarter out of a hundred percent, mainly the white people, have been misled by what jazz was, is and should be or will be, by the pseudo-teachers, who think they’re teaching you but they’re really not. The first thing you don’t do, and your boy gave me credit for this too, Doc, what’s his name? He gave me credit today for bringing up the church. I started, that’s why I started talking first.
